events.content:
Created `middleware.ts` in the project root. It logs every request's HTTP method and pathname to the console (server-side stdout). The middleware runs on all routes by default — when a request comes in, you'll see output like:

```
GET /
GET /about
POST /api/data
```

If you want to limit it to specific routes, you can add a `config` export with a `matcher`, e.g.:

```ts
export const config = {
  matcher: ["/api/:path*", "/dashboard/:path*"],
};
```

content.text:
Created `middleware.ts` in the project root. It logs every request's HTTP method and pathname to the console (server-side stdout). The middleware runs on all routes by default — when a request comes in, you'll see output like:

```
GET /
GET /about
POST /api/data
```

If you want to limit it to specific routes, you can add a `config` export with a `matcher`, e.g.:

```ts
export const config = {
  matcher: ["/api/:path*", "/dashboard/:path*"],
};
```
